text: Built yolo-twice under code/ as a Bun/TypeScript monorepo: a core that ingests ~/.claude JSONL into redacted events, analyzers for the zoom tree, mermaid graph and search, a Node engine daemon with a CLI and a Claude Code plugin (/yolo-twice:yolo-twice), a React UI with linked timeline, graph, reader and follow mode, and a VitePress site plus Slidev deck deployed to GitHub Pages. Committed .yolo-twice history had to merge cleanly and avoid leaking usernames, so shared files were split to one writer each (per-session meta.json, with cursors, project list and personal attention in gitignored cache or local.json), absolute paths became $PROJECT, ~ and <user>, and resume now rebuilds into the cache and runs claude --resume <file> --fork-session. Outcome: 50 unit tests and 30+ headless browser checks pass and Pages deploys, with fixes for duplicate events under concurrent writers, mid-turn prompts being dropped, and --bare breaking the summarizer's login; Roland's sessions still need his engine restarted to rewrite their paths.
